title: Let it run
text: What do you do with your first touch?
tip: Look to the side the ball is going, before it arrives. Then your first touch can take you there.

options.why: Your look showed nobody on your right. Let it run and you are away into room.

options.text: Take it back the way it came
options.why: You keep the ball, but you turn back towards the opponent on the left.
Safe, but you had room to go forward and wasted it.

scan.prompt: Ball's coming to you from the left. Look first.
